name: codex-mod
description: Subagent types codex-mod:codex, sol, sol-high and astra-audit answered by the local OpenAI Codex CLI (codex exec) instead of an Anthropic model.

codexPath.title: Codex binary
codexPath.description: Absolute path of the codex executable. Empty: found on PATH, then in common install locations.

defaultModel.title: Default model (codex agent)
defaultModel.description: Model of the generic codex-mod:codex agent. Empty: the first model Codex lists.

defaultEffort.title: Default reasoning effort (codex agent)
defaultEffort.description: Reasoning effort of the generic codex-mod:codex agent; must be one the model supports.

defaultSandbox.title: Default sandbox (codex agent)
defaultSandbox.description: codex exec --sandbox of the generic codex-mod:codex agent.

roles.title: Role agents
roles.description: Which role agents to register besides codex: sol, sol-high, astra-audit.

lean.title: Lean Codex launches
lean.description: Turn off Codex plugins, apps, skills instructions, web search, multi-agent and the MCP servers of the Codex config for each launch (about half the input tokens per model call).

globalRules.title: Load global Codex rules
globalRules.description: Off (experimental): run Codex with a plugin-owned CODEX_HOME that links only auth.json, config.toml and models_cache.json, so the user-level AGENTS.md is not loaded.

extraConfig.title: Extra Codex config
extraConfig.description: Advanced: raw key=value overrides passed as -c to every launch (model, model_reasoning_effort and sandbox_mode are refused).

handbackMode.title: Handback mode
handbackMode.description: How the final answer reaches the caller: auto (SubagentHandback by default; plain text only after the tool answers that it is not active for the agent), tool, or text.

footer.title: Footer
footer.description: The line after each answer: full (agent, model, effort, sandbox, actions, Codex tokens, thread), short (agent, model, effort) or off.

nativeActions.title: Native action rows
nativeActions.description: Show Codex's commands and file changes as Bash/Edit/Write rows (never executed). Off: plain text lines in one step.

progressIntervalMs.title: Progress interval (ms)
progressIntervalMs.description: At most one action step per interval (0 to 60000).

maxActionsPerStep.title: Actions per step
maxActionsPerStep.description: The most Codex actions shown in one step (1 to 50).

timeoutMinutes.title: Run timeout (minutes)
timeoutMinutes.description: Stop a Codex run after this many minutes and report codex failed: timeout. 0: no timeout.

maxRunsPerWindow.title: Launch guard (runs per 10 min)
maxRunsPerWindow.description: The most Codex launches per agent in 10 minutes (1 to 100); beyond it the agent hands back codex failed: launch guard tripped. A message never gets more than one launch.

pruneDays.title: Keep agent records (days)
pruneDays.description: Agent records (thread, model, effort) not used for this many days are deleted (1 to 365).
